content: CSS filter on video: WebKit Bug 184601 - SVG url(#...) filters do NOT apply to video elements (accelerated/compositing codepath doesn't support url() refs); filter works on img but not video in Safari. iOS Safari gives a transformed video its own GPU layer and DROPS a CSS filter applied directly to it - filter must live on a NON-transformed ancestor wrapper (SferaDev commit evidence; WordPress core ticket #59104 confirms duotone filters fail on video in Safari 16.x). Plain filter functions (saturate(), brightness()) work but force compositing layers; animating filter = expensive, memory pressure on mobile GPU with 1080p video surfaces. Recommendation: apply saturate() to a static ancestor wrapper of the video, never the video itself, never a transformed element; keep degradation static (no filter animation) on low-end Android.
